description.en: Locks (or unlocks) a match member to a given field-position role, preventing the match AI from repositioning them freely.
True to lock the member's position role, false to unlock it.
Character ID string identifying the member to lock.
Optional lock mode (defaults to 2 if omitted).
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 3 arguments were given.
